THE FITTING EXPERIENCE

From first swing
to final spec.

A conversation, a few swings, and a clearer picture of what works for you.

01Book your session+

Choose a fitting and an available appointment in Acuity. Bring your current clubs so your fitter can understand your starting point.

02Establish your baseline+

Talk through your game, your goals and your budget. Assess your current setup before exploring alternatives.

03Hit. Compare. Refine.+

Test head and shaft combinations, then compare launch, spin, carry and consistency with your fitter.

04Find your fit+

Review the equipment specifications that suit your swing. Leave with a clear understanding of the recommendation and your next steps.
